messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: billing.token_count_delta[eu-west-1] > 15% (5m window) — triggered at 2024-04-15T03:15:13Z

maria: seeing repeated overage flags for ~7 customers, some spikes >2x baseline. Noticed around 03:10 UTC.

jon: taking oncall. pulling the metering pipeline now — is anything already customer-facing?

maria: automated overage emails queued by billing-bot. Please HOLD if possible.

billing-bot: hold_notifications=true applied to namespace:prod-billing at 03:16:05Z (requested by maria)

jon: logs show consumer lag on metering-agg-eu consumer group. grabbing kafka offsets.

ravi: quick excerpt from consumer lag check:
```
$ kafka-consumer-groups --describe --group metering-agg-eu
TOPIC                PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG
usage-events          0          1246782         1246905         123
usage-events          1          1102345         1102463         118
```
Looks like a backlog + burst around 03:08-03:12.

lisbeth: also seeing epk=null in emitter logs (idempotence key missing) which can cause replays to inflate counts. snippet:
```
2024-04-15T03:11:56Z emitter-4 INFO emit event_id=abc123 epk=null retries=3
```
Could be a producer bug + retry storm.

oncall-sre: @jon @ravi if it's epk null + retries, we should throttle emitter retries and restart the aggregator to avoid double-counting.

jon: agreed. plan: 1) mute notifications (done), 2) throttle emitter retry backoff to 10s, 3) restart metering-agg-eu consumers one-at-a-time, 4) run shadow-reconcile between shadow-collector-2 and primary for last 1h. ETA ~30m.

maria: customer impact note: overage flags are visible in UI but charges are not final until recon. Need comms ready in case we invalidate flags. No active billing charges yet (billing-processor marks as tentative).

ravi: executing restart of consumer partition 0 now. watching lag.

jon: restart completed for partition 0 at 03:29Z — lag dropped from 123 -> 12 and processing throughput back to normal.

billing-bot: notifications remain held. manual review required to release.

lisbeth: starting reconcile job between shadow-collector-2 and primary. Running incremental diff for 03:00-03:30 window.

jon: if reconcile shows >0.5% divergence we escalate to SEV2. Otherwise we'll plan a targeted replay and compact counts.

incident-bot: incident severity set to SEV3 by jon at 03:32:10Z.

maria: action items: 
- jon: finish consumer restarts + confirm throughput (done for p0)
- ravi: continue reconcile + produce divergence report
- lisbeth: own postmortem and remediation (epk producer fix)
- oncall-sre: prepare customer comms template in case we need to invalidate overage flags

jon: divergence report: preliminary diff ~0.9% (mainly tied to emitter retries on 3 producers). Recon job continuing to refine.

maria: recommend we keep holds on notifications for at least 2 hours until final reconciliation.

oncall-sre: copied comms draft to #customer-comm: "We observed anomalous usage spikes due to internal retry storm; working to reconcile flags; no charges applied until confirmed."

jon: moving to monitoring state — will keep thread updated. If recon finishes cleanly we'll lift holds and close. If not, escalate to SEV2.

maria: thanks all — tagging lisbeth for postmortem. pls note timeline and commands used for RCA.

lisbeth: acknowledged. I'll own the postmortem and coordinate credits for affected customers if needed.

jon: last check 03:39Z — processing steady, divergence trending down to 0.2%. Keeping hold.

maria: closing live mitigation; leave thread open for postmortem updates.

incident-bot: thread updated with runbook tag: "billing-count-drift"
